title: Service Delivery Manager – IT Operations & Support Services
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

At **Siemens**, we believe reliable IT services are the backbone of digital transformation. We empower our teams to drive operational excellence, innovation, automation, and continuous improvement while delivering secure, scalable, and business-critical IT services across the enterprise.

We're looking for a **Service Delivery Manager – IT Operations & Support Services** to join our team and play a key role in owning, managing, and continuously improving our enterprise IT operations and support services.

**You'll make a difference by:**

* Taking ownership of an enterprise-wide **IT Operations and Support Service** covering IT infrastructure and a portfolio of non-custom applications.
* Driving the management, performance, governance, and continual improvement of IT services in collaboration with local and global stakeholders.
* Maintaining accurate service documentation, operational procedures, service catalogs, and support models.
* Proactively identifying service risks, implementing mitigation strategies, and ensuring service continuity.
* Challenging ineffective operational practices and driving process optimization initiatives.
* Leading service improvement programs through automation, standardization, and implementation of **GitOps** practices.
* Managing major incidents and coordinating bridge calls to ensure rapid restoration of critical services.
* Monitoring service performance through KPIs, SLAs, operational dashboards, and governance reviews.
* Working closely with service owners, technical teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to ensure service excellence.
* Driving compliance, audit readiness, and adherence to enterprise IT governance standards.
* Leading automation initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness and reduce manual effort.
* Providing regular operational reporting and strategic recommendations to management and leadership teams.

**You'll win us over by:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **8-12 years of overall IT experience** with strong exposure to IT Infrastructure, Operations, and Service Management.
* Minimum **3+ years of Service Delivery Management or IT Operations Management experience** in a complex enterprise environment.
* Experience managing business-critical services involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Hands-on technical background in system administration, network administration, or infrastructure support.
* ITIL certification and other relevant industry certifications are highly desirable.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong experience in **IT Service Management (ITSM)** principles and operational governance.
* Practical experience with ITSM platforms including service configuration, workflow management, dashboarding, and reporting.
* Proven expertise in managing **business-critical IT services** and ensuring service availability and reliability.
* Experience handling and coordinating **Major and Critical Incidents**.
* Strong understanding of **ITIL-aligned Service Management processes**.
* Experience in:
* + Service Delivery Management
  + Support Service Management
  + Capacity and Workload Planning
  + KPI and SLA Management
  + Compliance and Governance Management
  + Supplier/Vendor Management
  + Service Reporting and Executive Communication
  + Continuous Service Improvement
  + Automation and Operational Excellence Initiatives
* Knowledge of **Cloud Technologies** at infrastructure and platform levels.
* Familiarity with **Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and GitOps frameworks**.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve governance, operational, and service-quality challenges.
* Experience applying **AI-powered tools and automation** to improve operational productivity and service performance.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership capabilities.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience managing globally distributed support and operations teams.
* Project and Program Management experience.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation platforms, and modern cloud operations.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Monitoring, Observability, and Service Reliability practices.
* Experience driving digital transformation and operational modernization initiatives.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to Continuous Delivery and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* + ITIL Foundation/Intermediate/Managing Professional
  + PMP / PRINCE2
  + Scrum Master / SAFe
  + Microsoft Azure / AWS Certifications
  + DevOps Certifications

**What You'll Gain**

* Opportunity to lead and transform enterprise-scale IT Operations and Support Services.
* Exposure to modern digital operations, automation, cloud technologies, and GitOps practices.
* Collaboration with global teams across business, technology, and operations domains.
* Ownership of strategic initiatives that directly impact service quality and business outcomes.
* A culture focused on innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* The ability to drive operational excellence and influence the future of enterprise IT services.

**Additional Information**

* **Location:** Pune, India
* **Team Size:** 11-member service team based in Pune
* **Service Ownership Model:** Shared responsibility between local organization and global headquarters
* **Service Coverage:** 08:00 CET to 17:00 CET

This role, based in Pune, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.

At Siemens, we are a collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, worldwide. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

* You possess excellent communication, sharp analytical abilities, and proven design skills
* You have detailed knowledge of modern software development lifecycles including CI / CD
* You have the ability to operate across a broad and complex business unit with multiple stakeholders
* You have an understanding of the key aspects of finance especially as related to Technology. Specifically including total cost of ownership and value
* You are a self-starter, highly motivated, and have a real passion for actively learning and researching new methods of work and new technology
* You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with team members at various levels, including business leaders

**What could set you apart**

* Experience managing Kanban processes, and various techniques to prioritize critical issues or features in a customer-support setting.
* Experience working with AI tooling (e.g. Gemini CodeAssist, GitHub CoPilot)
* UI development (e.g. HTML, JavaScript, AngularJS, Angular4/5 and Bootstrap)

* Software development best practices such as TDD (e.g. JUnit), automated testing (e.g. Gauge, Cucumber, FitNesse), continuous integration (e.g. Jenkins, GoCD)

* Relational databases (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL)
* Cloud computing, SaaS (Software as a Service)
* Atlassian tooling (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, and Bitbucket)
* Experience working in financial services
* Experience working with open source frameworks; preferably Spring, though we would also consider Ruby, Apache Struts, Symfony, Django, etc.
* Automated Testing: JUnit, Selenium, LoadRunner, SoapUI

**Behaviors:**

* Customer-focused with a drive to exceed expectations.
* Demonstrates integrity and accountability.
* Intellectually curious and driven to innovate.
* Values diversity and fosters collaboration.
* Results-oriented with a sense of urgency and agility.

We offer a hybrid work setting, comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages, attractive paid time off, and organizational growth potential through our online learning platform with guided career tracks.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

**Who is Equifax?**

At Equifax, we believe knowledge drives progress. As a global data, analytics and technology company, we play an essential role in the global economy by helping employers, employees, financial institutions and government agencies make critical decisions with greater confidence.

We work to help create seamless and positive experiences during life’s pivotal moments: applying for jobs or a mortgage, financing an education or buying a car. Our impact is real and to accomplish our goals we focus on nurturing our people for career advancement and their learning and development, supporting our next generation of leaders, maintaining an inclusive and diverse work environment, and regularly engaging and recognizing our employees. Regardless of location or role, the individual and collective work of our employees makes a difference and we are looking for talented team players to join us as we help people live their financial best.

Equifax is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

description:

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Project Manager / Technical Lead – Vulnerability Enrichment Tool (VET) Close & Verify Governance**

**Job Description Summary**

The Project Manager / Technical Lead will be responsible for coordinating, governing, and driving the end-to-end **Vulnerability Enrichment Tool (VET) Close & Verify process** across all CIO areas. This role acts as the central point of coordination between Engineering teams, Application Owners, SMEs, Security teams, and senior stakeholders to ensure timely remediation, verification, reporting, and governance of vulnerability management activities.

The successful candidate will combine strong project management, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and operational governance skills to drive remediation outcomes, improve process effectiveness, and enhance adoption of VET and Control Workbench (CWB) capabilities across Deutsche Bank Technology.

**Education**

Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cyber Security, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in Technology, Cyber Security, Risk Management, Application Development, Infrastructure, or Technology Governance functions.
* 5+ years of project/program management experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Proven experience working with technology engineering teams, application owners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience delivering large-scale remediation, transformation, or regulatory initiatives.
* Experience operating within global organizations and distributed teams.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, DevOps, Vulnerability Management, and IT Risk Management frameworks.
* Experience working within regulated financial institutions is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**VET Close & Verify Governance**

* Lead and coordinate the VET "Close & Verify" process across all CIO organizations.
* Drive vulnerability remediation activities from identification through closure verification.
* Ensure timely review and disposition of vulnerability buckets generated through VET.
* Coordinate with ITAOs, Delegates, Engineers, Developers, SMEs, and Security teams to achieve remediation targets.
* Govern vulnerability remediation KPIs, SLAs, and risk reduction objectives.
* Track remediation progress and escalate risks, blockers, and aging vulnerabilities where appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement of vulnerability handling processes and governance controls.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact between CIO teams, CSO Cyber Hygiene teams, engineering functions, and governance forums.
* Facilitate daily and weekly remediation review sessions with engineering teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional working groups to resolve complex vulnerability remediation challenges.
* Present status updates, metrics, risks, and remediation progress to senior management.
* Build effective relationships across Technology, Information Security, Risk, and Audit stakeholders.

**Operational Effectiveness & Process Improvement**

* Drive automation opportunities across vulnerability ingestion, analysis, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement operational improvements.
* Support enhancement initiatives within Control Workbench (CWB) and VET.
* Promote end-to-end traceability from vulnerability identification through close and verify activities.
* Support onboarding, training, awareness, and adoption activities across the Technology organization.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Monitor and report on:
* + Vulnerability remediation progress
  + Open and overdue findings
  + Exception management status
  + Risk exposure trends
  + CIO and application-level performance metrics
* Support governance forums and steering committees with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Ensure audit-ready evidence and remediation traceability are maintained.

**Risk & Exception Management**

* Coordinate central exception review processes.
* Ensure proper documentation and approval of risk acceptances and exceptions.
* Validate remediation evidence submitted by engineering teams.
* Support regulatory, audit, and internal review activities relating to vulnerability management.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Mandatory Skills**

**Project & Program Management**

* Strong project management and delivery leadership experience.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams across global organizations.
* Proven ability to drive delivery against challenging timelines.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Experience managing executive stakeholders and governance forums.

**Technical Leadership**

* Strong understanding of software engineering and infrastructure environments.
* Working knowledge of:
* + Vulnerability Management
  + Application Security
  + SDLC
  + DevOps
  + Cloud Platforms
  + Infrastructure Operations
* Ability to engage effectively with developers, engineers, architects, and security professionals.
* Experience translating technical issues into management-level reporting.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Experience working with senior technology executives and governance bodies.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with vulnerability management platforms.
* Experience using Control Workbench (CWB) or similar governance tooling.
* Knowledge of vulnerability assessment frameworks including:
* + CVE
  + CVSS
  + Vulnerability Scanning methodologies
  + Cyber Hygiene processes
* Knowledge of patch management and infrastructure remediation processes.
* Experience working on regulatory remediation programs.
* Experience in audit, risk, compliance, or governance functions.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, and Power BI.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong leadership and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical and investigative abilities.
* Ability to operate effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused and outcome-driven approach.
* Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to drive change and process transformation.
* Commitment to operational excellence, governance, and continuous improvement.

**Success Measures**

The successful candidate will be accountable for:

* Reduction in aging vulnerabilities and open remediation backlog.
* Improved Close & Verify completion rates across CIO areas.
* Increased remediation and verification accuracy.
* Enhanced operational efficiency through automation.
* Improved dashboard transparency and management reporting.
* Strong governance, auditability, and end-to-end traceability.
* Effective stakeholder engagement and process adoption.
* Reduction of risk exposure across Technology platforms.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Senior Manager, IT Program Management
description:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we're dedicated to developing ground\-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting\-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient\-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.


The Anaplan Center of Excellence ( CoE ) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. As Sr. Project Manager, you will orchestrate the delivery of new applications and the continuous enhancement of the existing portfolio, working with a globally distributed team of developers and administrators and with business partners across multiple functions and time zones.


**How** **you'll** **make an impact:**

* Orchestrate a portfolio of concurrent Anaplan initiatives – new application builds and enhancement/update releases – across multiple use case families (e.g., financial planning \& analysis, commercial and sales planning, operational planning), balancing priorities, dependencies, and shared resources across 50\+ applications.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: intake and business case, detailed requirements definition, scoping, planning, build coordination, testing/UAT, deployment, and hypercare , using a hybrid delivery methodology (Agile sprints for build, stage\-gate/Waterfall controls for planning and release).
* Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of a distributed CoE team – 8–11 Anaplan developers in Pune and administrator resources in Prague and the US – without direct people\-management responsibility: plan sprints and releases, remove blockers, manage capacity and sequencing across projects.
* Partner with the enterprise data team on data integration requirements, source availability, and interface timelines; align delivery plans with data pipeline readiness.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.
* Maintain the CoE delivery roadmap and release calendar; manage changes to scope, schedule, and cost so plans remain accurate and reflect authorized changes.
* Actively manage project risks and issues; monitor performance, identify and quantify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Facilitate creation and approval of business cases and prioritization decisions, using historical data and expert judgment to understand constraints.
* Strengthen CoE delivery governance: standardize intake, estimation, status reporting, and release management practices; lead continuous improvement of PM processes within the CoE .
* Manage project closure activities, including lessons learned, and drive resulting improvements into future releases.
* Serve as a project management subject matter expert within the CoE ; guide and mentor team members on delivery practices.
* Other incidental duties.
**What** **you'll** **need (Required):**

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* A minimum of eight years of hands\-on experience managing software delivery projects of increasing complexity, or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria.
* Project Management Professional (PMP); if not, Green Belt, Black Belt, or Scrum Master certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery with globally distributed teams and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
* Experience running hybrid delivery models (Agile/Scrum combined with Waterfall/stage\-gate governance).
* This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, working second shift with overlap to European (CET) and partial US working hours.
**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience delivering Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / connected planning implementations on any platform (e.g., Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud/BPC, OneStream, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment).
* Understanding of planning processes in finance (budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning) and/or commercial functions (sales forecasting, quota and territory planning).
* Experience working alongside data engineering teams on integrations (ETL/ELT, APIs, data hubs).
* Demonstrated experience with SDLC project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps) and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet).
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and related project management systems.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives .
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent understanding of and work experience with project budgets and financial management .
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry.

title: SAP Ariba Consultant
description:
SAP Ariba Solution Implementation and Enhancement
  

  

Support the implementation, enhancement, and optimization of SAP Ariba procurement solutions.
  

Focus on Guided Buying, catalogs, approval workflows, SAP Business Network, and downstream procurement processes.
  

Support configuration and implementation activities in SAP Ariba.
  

Contribute to the design and implementation of process improvements in Guided Buying and related procurement scenarios.
  

Support additional SAP Ariba solutions, such as Buying and Invoicing, Sourcing, and Supplier Management, where applicable.
  

Support custom development and enhancements within the relevant add\-on environment.
  

Ensure the functional and technical quality of project deliverables.
  

Contribute to the standardization, reusability, and continuous improvement of SAP Ariba solutions.  

  

  

  

Integration and Technical Architecture Support
  

  

Support and coordinate integration scenarios between SAP Ariba and SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA systems.
  

Contribute to CIG\-based integration scenarios and SAP Business Network connectivity.
  

Support API\- and service\-based integration topics, including REST APIs, web services, SCIM APIs for user provisioning, and SSL\-encrypted SOAP API calls.
  

Contribute to the understanding and implementation of enterprise Ariba architecture involving MDG\-S, SAP IPS, SAP IAS, and IAM.
  

Coordinate with integration specialists, middleware teams, master data teams, and external partners.
  

Analyze and resolve interface\-related defects, data inconsistencies, and integration failures.
  

Support stable and reliable end\-to\-end procurement processes across connected systems.

Work closely with procurement stakeholders, key users, global process owners, IT colleagues, and external implementation partners.
  

Lead or co\-lead international SAP Ariba projects and rollout activities.
  

Coordinate the implementation of cross\-functional business requirements.
  

Provide consulting and guidance regarding solution options, dependencies, risks, and implementation approaches.
  

Support project planning, prioritization, status reporting, and issue management.
  

Contribute to governance, standardization, and continuous improvement of digital procurement processes.
  

Work effectively in agile or hybrid project environments, including Scrum and Kanban where applicable.

Conduct functional and technical validation of implemented solutions.

Support troubleshooting across configuration, integration, catalog, workflow, user provisioning, and authorization\-related topics.

Ensure that solutions meet defined functional, technical, and quality requirements.

**Main purpose of the position** **(% of Time)**

* The Expert Professional SAP Ariba Consultant is responsible for the design, implementation, enhancement, integration, rollout, and support of SAP Ariba procurement solutions in an international environment.
* The position supports internal customers in setting up, further developing, and improving digital procurement processes. The role acts as a senior functional and technical counterpart for business stakeholders, key users, global process owners, internal IT teams, and external implementation partners.
* The position focuses on SAP Ariba Procurement, particularly Guided Buying, catalog\-based procurement, approval workflows, SAP Business Network, and CIG\-based integration scenarios. The role is responsible for analyzing business requirements, translating them into robust and sustainable solution concepts, supporting configuration and implementation activities, and ensuring alignment between business requirements and SAP Ariba capabilities.
* The position also supports the integration of SAP Ariba with SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA systems, as well as connected applications and platforms. Additional responsibilities include testing, troubleshooting, documentation, quality assurance, international rollouts, change management, user adoption, and continuous improvement.
* The role requires comprehensive SAP Ariba knowledge, a sound understanding of procurement processes, strong integration capabilities, excellent stakeholder\-management skills, and the ability to work effectively in international and cross\-functional teams.

* Analyze incoming business requirements together with key users, procurement stakeholders, and process owners.

* Define scalable, maintainable, and business\-oriented solution approaches.
* Prepare functional concepts, solution designs, process flows, and implementation documentation.
* Assess dependencies, risks, solution alternatives, and implementation effort.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements and SAP Ariba solution capabilities.
